name: vwap_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, every institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithm benchmarks against the session VWAP; when NIFTY tests VWAP 3+ times, each test partially exhausts the opposing resting limit orders defending that level. The eventual decisive break — accompanied by a volume surge 2x the recent 5-minute average — signals that VWAP-benchmarked buyers (or sellers) have overwhelmed the opposition and are aggressively filling their remaining order quantity. At this moment, stop-loss orders from VWAP-fade traders trigger simultaneously, creating a self-reinforcing cascade. At 5-second resolution, we enter within one bar of the surge bar, capturing the first 20-25 NIFTY spot points of institutional-driven continuation before the move partially exhausts.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume) from 09:15 per day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no scaling needed. This is the canonical institutional benchmark level that resets each day. Identical to original in concept.

indicators.name: vwap_touch_episode_count
indicators.formula: count of distinct episodes per day where abs(close - vwap)/vwap < 0.05%
indicators.purpose: Counts how many times NIFTY has tested VWAP today. Consecutive bars near VWAP count as one episode. Session-cumulative, no lookback scaling — the 3-touch requirement is a session-level structural filter, not a rolling indicator. Same threshold as original (0.05% ≈ 11 NIFTY pts at 22000).

indicators.name: volume_sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling average volume (60 bars × 5s). Original used 20 bars on 1-min = 20-minute baseline. We compress to 5 minutes because at 5-second resolution, intraday volume is spikier and a 5-minute baseline is sufficient to detect a genuine surge without the 20-minute lag creating false positives in high-volume open vs quiet midday.

indicators.name: side_before_break
indicators.purpose: 3.3-minute consensus of which side of VWAP price occupied. Original used 20 1-min bars (20 minutes). We compress to 40 bars (3.3 min) because we need to confirm the RECENT dominant side before the current breakout bar — 3 minutes is long enough to establish the 'other side' context without being so long it includes the break itself.

conditions: close > vwap * 1.001 (decisive break above VWAP by >0.1%)
vwap_touch_episode_count >= 3 (VWAP tested at least 3 times today)
side_before_break < -0.3 (price was predominantly below VWAP over last 3.3 min)
volume / volume_sma_60 > 2.0 (break bar has 2x average volume)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions on the same 5-second bar — no additional bar delay needed at this frequency

conditions: close < vwap * 0.999 (decisive break below VWAP by >0.1%)
side_before_break > 0.3 (price was predominantly above VWAP over last 3.3 min)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 NIFTY spot pts adverse move at delta 0.5. If NIFTY reverses 10 pts against the breakout direction within 30-120s, the multi-test break has failed and price is re-entering the old range. A 10 spot pt reversal from VWAP break level is the signal of thesis failure — it matches the 'VWAP recross' exit logic from the original but expressed in option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 9 option pts = ~18 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. After a 3-test VWAP break with volume surge, the first continuation leg on NIFTY typically extends 20-30 spot pts before any meaningful pullback (consistent with 2-minute typical move of 5-10 option pts per CONVENTIONS table). Targeting 9 pts at 1:1.8 R:R captures the conservative lower bound of the expected continuation.

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 25 — high VIX sessions produce erratic VWAP tests; the multi-test setup loses its structural meaning above this threshold
filters.time_filter: entries only 10:00-14:30 IST (need minimum ~45 min for 3 VWAP tests to accumulate; late entries after 14:30 have insufficient hold time)
filters.trend_filter: none — strategy is directionally agnostic, signal fires for both CE and PE
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — multi-test VWAP break with volume is a specific setup; it's not codified in standard algo frameworks. High selectivity (0-3 trades/day) limits frequency but maintains quality.

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from original: (1) Execution precision: original waited for 2 full 1-min bars of confirmation after the break; at 5-second bars we fire on the break bar itself, entering ~30-60 seconds earlier and avoiding the 'late entry' problem where the first 2 confirmation bars have already consumed 30-40% of the expected move. (2) Volume baseline compressed: 20-min SMA → 5-min SMA because 5-second volume data has much higher granularity and the 5-min window is sufficient to detect genuine surges. (3) Stop expressed as spot-equivalent option pts (5 pts) rather than VWAP re-cross, which is more practical in options where we don't observe the underlying stop level directly.
weaknesses: Low frequency (0-3/day) limits P&L even if edge is present — the 3-touch filter is strict
Touch count threshold (0.05%) is somewhat arbitrary; different thresholds produce different counts, especially in volatile sessions
Volume surge detection at 5-second bars is noisier than at 1-minute bars — single 5-second high-volume bar may not indicate genuine institutional flow
Session VWAP can diverge significantly from price after large morning moves, making the strategy less effective in strong trending days
